cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: What Aren’t You Saying?
cards.instruction: Find out what someone is holding back by treating every careful answer as incomplete.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your verdict on my audition was 'interesting.' I'm returning it for more detail.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're my sister. I'm trying to be encouraging.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Encouragement is permitted. Omissions aren't. Give me the half you swallowed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your singing was better than your dancing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That comparison isn't approved as a complete answer. Tell me whether I'm booking dance lessons or asking for a number I can sing standing still.
